p10/esc1000:0.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:0.text: Hi I am seeking support to assist me with better sleep patterns.

p10/esc1000:1.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:1.text: Hi there, let me get a deeper understanding of your existing sleep pattern. Do you suffer from insomnia or another type of sleep disorder?

p10/esc1000:10.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:10.text: I wish there were more caring people in the world.

p10/esc1000:11.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:11.text: Kindness is contagious, and you definitely have a kind heart. As long as you remain soft in a hard world, people will recognize that and follow suit. The world is becoming more aware, and we have the power to raise future generations with more knowledge and love for one another. Caring doesn't come naturally to many unfortunately, but the ways of inspiring the people that don't care, are endless. We as a society can definitely think of more ways to care for one another.

p10/esc1000:12.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:12.text: Correct, but having a kind heart does not keep me from waking up & worrying about my son and other black men in my family.

p10/esc1000:13.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:13.text: I worry about my sons and husband and father all the time... I shift my focus on loving them and cherishing every moment we have together. Police or not, the time we have is not promised..

p10/esc1000:16.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:16.text: A hot cup of tea never hurt too! But in all seriousness, I can completely understand your sleep troubles. It is much deeper than just that. Perspective is the key to life. You are a strong and empathetic soul.

p10/esc1000:20.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:20.text: I'm looking forward to a fulls night rest.

p10/esc1000:21.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:21.text: That is good, lavender baths or showers will also ease and relax the troubled mind.

p10/esc1000:23.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:23.text: I like to relax with a book and a blanket sometimes too.

p10/esc1000:25.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:25.text: Self care is definitely something we can overlook accidentally. Being self aware is a daily practice.

p10/esc1000:26.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:26.text: I agree.  Loving ourselves & the ones we care about too.

p10/esc1000:27.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:27.text: It is good that we spoke today, I am going to hug my sons a little harder when I see them tonight.

p10/esc1000:3.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:3.text: Okay, are you drinking enough water and eating a healthy diet?

p10/esc1000:4.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:4.text: I could improve my water intake and eat more vegatables.

p10/esc1000:5.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:5.text: I like to analyze my own habits every now and then, it helps me stay in check. You can definitely benefit from meditating and self reflecting.

p10/esc1000:6.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:6.text: Thanks!  What other ideas do you have?

p10/esc1000:7.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:7.text: Of course! I always knock right out after a workout. But if you aren't able to, just simple things like turning all the lights off at the same time every night and laying in bed will help. It will align your circadian rhythm!

p10/esc1000:8.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1000:8.text: Great, but I wake up frequently thinking about the recent events surrounding police and how they treat black people.

p10/esc1000:9.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1000:9.text: It definitely is a valid reason to be kept awake. The only good part about something so horrible, is that you have the power to make sure you will continue to be a good person. If everyone was as empathetic as you, the world would be a better place. Thank you for caring so deeply about such a brutal matter.

p10/esc1290:1.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:1.text: Hello, I am looking for help in managing some depression.

p10/esc1290:10.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:10.text: My son is very defiant and argues with us about everything we try and get him to do, but he expects us to give him money for fun things that he wants to do when he isn't willing to work or even help out around the house

p10/esc1290:11.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:11.text: Regardless of what your husband's actions are and your son's, could you possibly make the time to do things to support yourself, that even momentarily would provide you with some positive feelings?

p10/esc1290:12.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:12.text: I try to go for a run every night, that does help.

p10/esc1290:13.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:13.text: That is very hard emotionally, so I am sorry you have to deal with your son's behavior.

p10/esc1290:14.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:14.text: It is hard to keep my emotions separate from what is going on with him

p10/esc1290:15.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:15.text: That is very understandable! Setting boundaries for yourself may help. Even when it's difficult, being clear with your son that you will not be giving him money could help.

p10/esc1290:16.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:16.text: Sometimes being clear with your own expectations can help him to see what won't be accepted from him as long as he is living in your home.

p10/esc1290:17.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:17.text: Yes, I could do better at that.  I want him to have fun and do things with friends, but I want him to be willing to work for what he wants, too.

p10/esc1290:18.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:18.text: I do struggle with expectations.  I want him to be someone that he is not willing to be, I need to let go of that and just let him be himself and not base my emotions on his choices.

p10/esc1290:19.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:19.text: I completely understand that. Especially when it comes to people we are close to, it can be hard to separate our expectations from theirs.

p10/esc1290:2.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:2.text: You've come to a good place to start.

p10/esc1290:20.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:20.text: I feel guilty sometimes taking time to do things that I like and that are away from my family.  I can see that I need to do that more, though.

p10/esc1290:21.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:21.text: I've had to learn this lesson many times with my own children. It's difficult, but ultimately will give you some relief from your resentment.

p10/esc1290:22.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:22.text: Thank you, it is helpful to know that other people have felt the same way.

p10/esc1290:23.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:23.text: Absolutely! Being a parent is difficult. Remembering to support yourself helps. Making the time to do things to support your wellbeing doesn't make you selfish at all

p10/esc1290:26.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:26.text: Has any of this been helpful? Is there more I can do for you?

p10/esc1290:3.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:3.text: Is there something in particular that is leaving you feeling depressed?

p10/esc1290:4.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:4.text: I am feeling resentful towards my husband for quitting his job, and my son for being the reason that he quit his job.

p10/esc1290:5.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:5.text: My son's behavior is causing a lot of conflict in our house and my husband not working is putting a lot of financial stress on us

p10/esc1290:6.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:6.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Feeling resentment for both your husband's loss of work and your son's loss of his job is entirely understandable.

p10/esc1290:7.speaker: seeker
p10/esc1290:7.text: I have a hard time not dwelling on the negative things going on.  It's hard to see anything positive or feel hopeful for the future.

p10/esc1290:8.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:8.text: I have an adult son who also lost his job recently, and I understand the added stress that can cause in your household.

p10/esc1290:9.speaker: supporter
p10/esc1290:9.text: That is a really difficult position to be in.

p10/esc81:1.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:1.text: Hello, I hope you can help me.

p10/esc81:10.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:10.text: I honestly think you should bring it up to your boss

p10/esc81:11.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:11.text: Yes, I think so too.  I like my boss but he is funny about things sometimes.  Any ideas on how I could bring it up to him.  I hate feeling this way, my attitude is really turning sour.

p10/esc81:12.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:12.text: I can't believe he has not given you a raise by now

p10/esc81:14.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:14.text: Just tell him that you need to have a serious talk with him and tell him straight up what is on your mind don't hold it back

p10/esc81:15.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:15.text: So, I guess I'll have to be honest and brave at the same time.

p10/esc81:16.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:16.text: Do you think I should bring in proof....paperwork, etc.  I have been working extra as well.

p10/esc81:17.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:17.text: Yes I know you can do it but that is the only way to solve the situation is by communicating with him

p10/esc81:18.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:18.text: Yes that would help more by bringing in proof to him

p10/esc81:19.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:19.text: Ok, I am just so angry over the whole thing, I'm going to have to keep my cool and let him know without getting an attitude, do you think that will work?

p10/esc81:20.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:20.text: Yes just remain calm with him

p10/esc81:21.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:21.text: I will try, I hope I don't start crying!  I tend to get frustrated and cry.

p10/esc81:22.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:22.text: getting a attitude with him will not help at all

p10/esc81:23.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:23.text: Yes, you are right, it will make it a bad situation.

p10/esc81:24.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:24.text: Don't let this situation get to you so much

p10/esc81:27.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:27.text: I'll try not to, I have to be calm, like you said

p10/esc81:29.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:29.text: Thank you so much for your positive support!

p10/esc81:3.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:3.text: I work hard at my job in an office.  We acquired another company and my job is now twice the work.

p10/esc81:30.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:30.text: I'll let him know I need to talk and I'll remain calm

p10/esc81:31.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:31.text: Your welcome i am sure he will give you a raise once you talk to him

p10/esc81:32.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:32.text: Fingers crossed!  I really have gone above and beyond and feel I really deserve it.

p10/esc81:33.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:33.text: I will be praying that you get the raise because you deserve it

p10/esc81:34.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:34.text: Thank you so much, you've been very helpful!

p10/esc81:4.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:4.text: Two of my coworkers have gotten a raise and I have not gotten anything!

p10/esc81:5.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:5.text: Have you talked to your boss about it?

p10/esc81:6.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:6.text: I have hinted around that my job is sooo busy and he knows it, I haven't come out and said anything yet.

p10/esc81:7.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:7.text: I can understand how you feeling you work extremely hard and get no raise when you deserve it

p10/esc81:8.speaker: seeker
p10/esc81:8.text: Yes, I have been at the job for 15 years and make a decent salary but this amount of work is insane.  Do you think I should bring it up to him>

p10/esc81:9.speaker: supporter
p10/esc81:9.text: oh wow 15 years? I really believe you need a raise and doing more work now.

p10/p10_conv_10:0.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:0.text: Hey Emily, how have you been doing lately?

p10/p10_conv_10:1.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:1.text: Hi there, it's been a bit of a rollercoaster, honestly.

p10/p10_conv_10:10.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:10.text: That sounds like a good plan. Sometimes having a discussion with the school can help in finding solutions together.

p10/p10_conv_10:11.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:11.text: I hope so. I just can't help but feel guilty, like I'm not doing enough to protect him.

p10/p10_conv_10:12.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:12.text: It's normal to feel that way, but remember, you’re doing what you can by being attentive and proactive about the situation.

p10/p10_conv_10:13.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:13.text: Thanks. It's just with everything else happening, like when Jerry left, sometimes I feel like I'm losing control of everything.

p10/p10_conv_10:14.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:14.text: It's a lot to carry on your shoulders. Losing control can bring up all kinds of emotions. Have you been able to find anything helpful to ground you during these times?

p10/p10_conv_10:15.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:15.text: Therapy has been helpful, and Bob’s new job does lift some of the financial stress. I'm just trying to keep everything balanced.

p10/p10_conv_10:16.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:16.text: That's a lot of positive progress, Emily. Having Bob's support and attending therapy is a big step towards managing everything that's going on.

p10/p10_conv_10:17.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:17.text: Thank you. I guess I need to be kinder to myself and remember it's okay to lean on others sometimes.

p10/p10_conv_10:18.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:18.text: Absolutely. You’re doing your best in tough circumstances. Needing support is completely okay, and it sounds like you've got a good plan in place.

p10/p10_conv_10:19.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:19.text: I really appreciate you listening. It helps to talk it through with someone who understands.

p10/p10_conv_10:2.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:2.text: I can imagine. There have been quite a few changes recently, right? Would you like to share what's been on your mind?

p10/p10_conv_10:20.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:20.text: Anytime, Emily. Remember, you're not alone in this. Let's check in again soon, how does that sound?

p10/p10_conv_10:21.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:21.text: That sounds great. Thank you again for being there.

p10/p10_conv_10:22.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:22.text: You're welcome. Take care, and talk to you soon!

p10/p10_conv_10:3.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:3.text: Well, Bob just got a full-time job, which is a huge relief financially. But I’m still feeling quite overwhelmed.

p10/p10_conv_10:4.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:4.text: That's great news about Bob's job! But it's understandable that other things have been weighing on you. What do you think is contributing to your feelings of being overwhelmed?

p10/p10_conv_10:5.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:5.text: It's mostly George. I'm still so worried about him being bullied at school. I just don't know how to help him feel safe.

p10/p10_conv_10:6.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:6.text: That sounds incredibly difficult. It's heart-wrenching to see our kids go through tough times like that. How is George coping?

p10/p10_conv_10:7.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:7.text: He seems okay on the surface, but I can tell it's affecting him. He's become quieter at home, and I think he's trying to hide his feelings.

p10/p10_conv_10:8.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_10:8.text: It's painful to know he's keeping it inside. Have you been able to talk to him, or his teachers, about what's been happening?

p10/p10_conv_10:9.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_10:9.text: I've tried talking to him, but he just says everything is okay. I'm planning to meet with his teacher soon to see what they can do.

p10/p10_conv_11:0.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:0.text: Hey, I just need someone to talk to right now.

p10/p10_conv_11:1.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:1.text: Of course, Emily. I'm here for you. What's been going on?

p10/p10_conv_11:10.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:10.text: I thought things were getting better with Bob's new job and the positive feedback from my boss. But now it feels like I'm back at square one with worry.

p10/p10_conv_11:11.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:11.text: Progress isn't always a straight line, although it feels like a setback now, you've managed so much already. You're very strong.

p10/p10_conv_11:12.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:12.text: Thank you for saying that. It's just hard to see my kids go through this. I want to protect them, but sometimes I feel helpless.

p10/p10_conv_11:13.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:13.text: Wanting to protect your children is natural. It doesn't make you helpless; it shows how deeply you care.

p10/p10_conv_11:14.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:14.text: That makes sense. I've been trying to focus on the positives, like Bob's new job and how George is feeling better now.

p10/p10_conv_11:15.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:15.text: That's a great approach, Emily. Focusing on those positives can help ground you during tough times.

p10/p10_conv_11:16.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:16.text: I miss having Jerry around, though. Him leaving just added to everything.

p10/p10_conv_11:17.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:17.text: It's tough when a family member moves away unexpectedly. Have you had any chance to reconnect with him since he left?

p10/p10_conv_11:18.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:18.text: We've exchanged a couple of texts, but it's not the same. I'm hoping he'll come around eventually.

p10/p10_conv_11:19.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:19.text: I hope so too. It's hard, but giving it time and keeping the door open for when he's ready to reconnect is a loving way to handle it.

p10/p10_conv_11:2.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:2.text: It's about George. He had this really scary allergic reaction and ended up in the hospital.

p10/p10_conv_11:20.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:20.text: Yeah, I'm trying to keep that in mind. It's comforting to at least talk this out.

p10/p10_conv_11:21.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:21.text: Anytime, Emily. You're doing your best, and it shows. Remember, you're never alone in this.

p10/p10_conv_11:22.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:22.text: Thanks for being here for me. It does make things feel a bit easier.

p10/p10_conv_11:23.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:23.text: I'm really glad to hear that. Take care of yourself, and remember to reach out whenever you need.

p10/p10_conv_11:3.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:3.text: Oh no, that sounds terrifying! Is he alright now?

p10/p10_conv_11:4.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:4.text: Yeah, he's okay now, but I just can't seem to shake the anxiety after everything that happened.

p10/p10_conv_11:5.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:5.text: It's totally understandable to feel anxious after something like that. You must have been so worried.

p10/p10_conv_11:6.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:6.text: I really was. I kept thinking about what could have happened if we hadn't gotten to the hospital in time.

p10/p10_conv_11:7.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:7.text: It's frightening to think about those 'what ifs.' But you did get him there in time, and he's safe now.

p10/p10_conv_11:8.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_11:8.text: I know, but having to stay strong through it all is exhausting. And it brings back all those feelings from when he was bullied.

p10/p10_conv_11:9.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_11:9.text: It sounds like there's been so much on your plate lately. It's okay to feel overwhelmed.

p10/p10_conv_12:0.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:0.text: Hi Emily, how have you been lately?

p10/p10_conv_12:1.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:1.text: Hey, I've been feeling quite out of it. I got into a minor car accident last week, and it's messing with my head.

p10/p10_conv_12:10.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:10.text: I can imagine. It's great to hear things are getting better financially and in your relationship. Managing anxiety on top of everything isn't easy.

p10/p10_conv_12:11.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:11.text: Yeah, balancing work, family, and now this accident, feels overwhelming sometimes. My nerves are just on edge.

p10/p10_conv_12:12.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:12.text: It's understandable why you feel that way. Have there been any changes or improvements at work considering the stress of everything going on?

p10/p10_conv_12:13.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:13.text: Work has been okay, surprisingly. After the positive feedback from my boss, I've been trying hard not to let stress overwhelm me, but this recent event threw me a curveball.

p10/p10_conv_12:14.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:14.text: It's amazing you're making strides at work despite all that's happening. How are things with your kids, especially George after the incident at school?

p10/p10_conv_12:15.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:15.text: George is doing better. We talked to his teachers, and they are keeping an eye on any bullying. He's still a bit shaken but slowly opening up.

p10/p10_conv_12:16.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:16.text: That's good to hear, Emily. You're doing your best for him, and it's important to recognize that. How about Jerry, have you heard from him lately?

p10/p10_conv_12:17.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:17.text: I got a brief text from Jerry last week. I miss him a lot, and it's tough not knowing if he'll come home soon. It's just another layer to this pile of worry.

p10/p10_conv_12:18.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:18.text: That sounds very hard, Emily. You're managing so much at once. Is there anything that has helped or comforted you lately?

p10/p10_conv_12:19.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:19.text: I've been trying to stick to the routines my therapist suggested, like meditating and setting small goals. It helps a bit but feels like there's always something new to address.

p10/p10_conv_12:2.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:2.text: Oh no, Emily. I'm sorry to hear that. Are you okay?

p10/p10_conv_12:20.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:20.text: It's encouraging that you're taking those steps. Remember, it's okay to have setbacks. What's one thing, maybe even a small joy, that keeps you going these days?

p10/p10_conv_12:21.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:21.text: Honestly, seeing George smile when I pick him up from school. His resilience amazes me and reminds me why I keep pushing through.

p10/p10_conv_12:3.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_12:3.text: Physically, I'm fine, just a few bruises. But my anxiety has skyrocketed since then.

p10/p10_conv_12:4.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_12:4.text: That makes sense. It's really common to feel anxious after something like that. Were you driving alone at the time?

p10/p10_conv_12:5.speaker: seeker

p10/p10_conv_7:17.text: That sounds like a good start. Remember, you're doing your best in a tough situation. It's okay to take small steps and be kind to yourself.

p10/p10_conv_7:18.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_7:18.text: Thank you, that really helps. I guess I just have to keep trying and hope things will get better.

p10/p10_conv_7:19.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_7:19.text: Absolutely, Emily. Keep holding on to that hope, and I'm here for you whenever you need to talk.

p10/p10_conv_7:2.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_7:2.text: Jerry left us. It was so sudden after a huge argument, and I feel lost.

p10/p10_conv_7:3.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_7:3.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. It must be incredibly hard for you. Do you want to talk about what led to the disagreement?

p10/p10_conv_7:4.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_7:4.text: We were arguing about his lack of responsibility and how he's ignoring his future. Maybe I was too harsh.

p10/p10_conv_7:5.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_7:5.text: It sounds like you're worried about his well-being and future, which is completely understandable. How are you feeling about the situation now?

p10/p10_conv_7:6.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_7:6.text: I'm torn. Part of me feels guilty, but another part feels exhausted from all the stress we've been through.

p10/p10_conv_7:7.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_7:7.text: It's okay to feel mixed emotions. You're dealing with a lot on your plate—work, family, and financial pressures. It's understandable to feel overwhelmed.

p10/p10_conv_7:8.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_7:8.text: Yeah, with Bob's job, Jerry's incident at school, and all... it feels never-ending. I just want a break.

p10/p10_conv_7:9.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_7:9.text: You've been through an extraordinary amount. Can your therapy sessions provide a space to process these feelings?

p10/p10_conv_8:0.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:0.text: Hey there, I guess I just needed to talk today.

p10/p10_conv_8:1.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:1.text: Of course, Emily. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?

p10/p10_conv_8:10.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:10.text: We talk... but it's mostly arguments. I feel like we're both just at our wits' end sometimes.

p10/p10_conv_8:11.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:11.text: It sounds really tough. Disagreements are hard, but it can be helpful to approach it as a team, looking for solutions together. Do you think that's possible?

p10/p10_conv_8:12.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:12.text: I hope so. It's just hard to communicate when we're both stressed and upset.

p10/p10_conv_8:13.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:13.text: Stress can definitely make communication harder. Your therapist might have some strategies that could help when you're feeling overwhelmed.

p10/p10_conv_8:14.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:14.text: Yeah, I'll mention it next time I see her. It could be helpful to have some new approaches.

p10/p10_conv_8:15.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:15.text: That's a great idea. How is everything going with your son and his situation at school?

p10/p10_conv_8:16.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:16.text: 's still having a tough time. He's grounded after the incident at school, and that's affecting us too. I just wish things could be simpler.

p10/p10_conv_8:17.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:17.text: That sounds really tough on all of you. It's okay to feel overwhelmed by everything. You mentioned Jerry left home after a disagreement too—how are you handling that?

p10/p10_conv_8:18.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:18.text: Honestly, I feel a mix of anger, sadness, and worry. I know he's an adult, but I wish he hadn't left like that.

p10/p10_conv_8:19.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:19.text: It's completely natural to have those feelings, Emily. You're a caring mother, and wanting your child close is understandable. Have you been able to reach out to him since then?

p10/p10_conv_8:2.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:2.text: Well, I got an unexpected compliment from my boss today about my recent performance at work.

p10/p10_conv_8:20.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:20.text: Not much. He needs space, I think. It's just hard to not be able to help him when he needs it.

p10/p10_conv_8:21.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:21.text: That must be really tough. Giving him space while being there if he needs support is a good balance. Try to focus on being ready for when he's ready to reconnect.

p10/p10_conv_8:22.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:22.text: Thanks for saying that. It's been a lot to handle, but I'm trying to stay hopeful.

p10/p10_conv_8:23.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:23.text: Hope is important. Taking things one step at a time can make it more manageable. Is there anything specific that's helped you manage your stress lately?

p10/p10_conv_8:24.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:24.text: I've started walking in the mornings to clear my head. It’s not much, but I think it helps.

p10/p10_conv_8:25.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:25.text: That sounds like a healthy habit. Small steps forward are definitely progress. Remember, I'm always here when you need to talk. You don't have to face things alone.

p10/p10_conv_8:26.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:26.text: Thank you. It's nice to know I have your support.

p10/p10_conv_8:3.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:3.text: That sounds like a positive development! How does that make you feel?

p10/p10_conv_8:4.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:4.text: Relieved, to some extent. It's been a while since I've felt good about my work.

p10/p10_conv_8:5.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:5.text: It's understandable given the increased workload and stress you've faced. It's great to hear some recognition is coming your way. What do you think brought about the compliment?

p10/p10_conv_8:6.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:6.text: I think I've finally adapted a bit to the changes after the acquisition, and I've been trying really hard to stay focused, even though it's tough with everything else going on.

p10/p10_conv_8:7.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:7.text: You've been putting in a lot of effort, and it shows. It's not easy to balance work stress with personal struggles. How have things been at home?

p10/p10_conv_8:8.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_8:8.text: Things with Bob are still stressful, with the financial strains and all. His part-time job has helped some, but there's still tension.

p10/p10_conv_8:9.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_8:9.text: Relationships can be challenging, especially under financial pressure. Have you two had any discussions about how to move forward?

p10/p10_conv_9:0.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:0.text: Hi Emily, how are you doing today?

p10/p10_conv_9:1.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:1.text: Hi. Not so good, honestly. I'm feeling really overwhelmed right now.

p10/p10_conv_9:10.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:10.text: I remember you mentioned that incident. That must be adding to your stress.

p10/p10_conv_9:11.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:11.text: It is. Along with everything else going on at home and work, it's just too much.

p10/p10_conv_9:12.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:12.text: It sounds like you're juggling a lot of challenges. It's okay to feel overwhelmed, but remember you're not alone in this.

p10/p10_conv_9:13.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:13.text: Thank you. I appreciate you listening. Sometimes it feels like I have to stay strong for everyone else, and it gets exhausting.

p10/p10_conv_9:14.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:14.text: You're doing an incredible job holding everything together. Remember, it's okay to take time for yourself, too.

p10/p10_conv_9:15.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:15.text: I know, you're right. I just really want things to improve, especially for George.

p10/p10_conv_9:16.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:16.text: It will. You're taking active steps to help him, and that's important. Have you talked to anyone else about this, like your husband or therapist?

p10/p10_conv_9:17.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:17.text: I've mentioned it briefly to my husband, but it's been tense between us with everything going on. I do plan to bring it up in my next therapy session.

p10/p10_conv_9:18.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:18.text: That's a good plan. I'm sure your therapist will have some helpful strategies to share as well.

p10/p10_conv_9:19.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:19.text: I hope so. Thanks for listening and supporting me. It really helps to talk it through.

p10/p10_conv_9:2.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?

p10/p10_conv_9:20.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:20.text: Anytime, Emily. You're doing your best, and that counts for so much. I'm here whenever you need to share or just need someone to listen.

p10/p10_conv_9:3.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:3.text: Well, I just found out that George, my youngest, is being bullied at school. It's really upsetting.

p10/p10_conv_9:4.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:4.text: That sounds really distressing. It's tough to know your child is struggling like that.

p10/p10_conv_9:5.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:5.text: Yes, it makes me feel so helpless. I want to protect him, but I'm not sure how to handle this.

p10/p10_conv_9:6.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:6.text: It's understandable to feel that way. Have you had a chance to talk to the school about it?

p10/p10_conv_9:7.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:7.text: Not yet. I'm planning to speak with his teacher soon. I just hope they're supportive and proactive.

p10/p10_conv_9:8.speaker: supporter
p10/p10_conv_9:8.text: It's a positive step that you're reaching out to the school. They'll likely want to work with you to ensure George is safe and comfortable.

p10/p10_conv_9:9.speaker: seeker
p10/p10_conv_9:9.text: I really hope so. I just keep thinking about the last time I had to meet with the school's principal because of Jerry's phone incident.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yeah, and it doesn't help that my job feels so unstable. I worry all the time about whether I'll be able to keep it.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: hi,I'm in depression because my kids not listen to me.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: That makes sense. I've been trying to focus on the positives, like Bob's new job and how George is feeling better now.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I try to go for a run every night, that does help.

f895fcbe2484a9f7e15e1008fe9e2f9582f88fd0.head: ME
f895fcbe2484a9f7e15e1008fe9e2f9582f88fd0.statement: feeling overwhelmed due to George's bullying and Jerry leaving home

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thanks. It's just with everything else happening, like when Jerry left, sometimes I feel like I'm losing control of everything.

f1ffef23e2e77b4c5cdc85362cd46c0b0f8c245e.head: ME
f1ffef23e2e77b4c5cdc85362cd46c0b0f8c245e.statement: attempted conversation with George about his emotional state

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I've tried talking to him, but he just says everything is okay. I'm planning to meet with his teacher soon to see what they can do.

227eaff2d34b7dcfe6844b408d82fadbdf56f437.head: ME
227eaff2d34b7dcfe6844b408d82fadbdf56f437.statement: seeker expressed difficulty managing anxiety after son's medical emergency

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yeah, he's okay now, but I just can't seem to shake the anxiety after everything that happened.

dc9d4e8c687f72b50ea5e1be706e5f80152376a2.head: ME
dc9d4e8c687f72b50ea5e1be706e5f80152376a2.statement: feeling guilty about not being able to protect George from bullying

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I hope so. I just can't help but feel guilty, like I'm not doing enough to protect him.
